title: Inner language
statement: Let $C_w,c_w$ be natural numbers and let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet. The inner language consists of exactly those Boolean words $w$ such that, for every Boolean word $v$, the paired encoding of $w$ and $v$ does not belong to the language of bad encodings with parameters $C_w,c_w$ and machine $M$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
